d2132ee47303a63ad4bbbad91db36561bed03b6e.speaker: PINDLE
d2132ee47303a63ad4bbbad91db36561bed03b6e.text: Stand back! No one is to touch the object until it has been documented, classified, categorized, and denied!

dcbaa61231da15fca60bb8cfed5da5ba993a9fe9.speaker: TIBBIT
dcbaa61231da15fca60bb8cfed5da5ba993a9fe9.text: Mystery. Bureaucracy. Possibly treasure. In that order.

0bb3bc03c38da65714e580c3f8a26ebcb693c07a.speaker: PINDLE
0bb3bc03c38da65714e580c3f8a26ebcb693c07a.text: Citizen, step away from the object.

e4c3330a0723876fe852fda9141c33f6573dbdd8.speaker: ROWAN
e4c3330a0723876fe852fda9141c33f6573dbdd8.text: That seems like a flaw in your profession.

96849a0e2ae805041338e45bd7d8cde101fffd06.speaker: ROWAN
96849a0e2ae805041338e45bd7d8cde101fffd06.text: ...I've had this thing since I was a child.

33ef71c5c1fa172e251b3c28960d3c487abf5995.speaker: PINDLE
33ef71c5c1fa172e251b3c28960d3c487abf5995.text: Excellent. Then under salvage law, you are now personally responsible for whatever catastrophe this becomes.

4dfef38956adb5179e3657297a53827d2c4e29ff.speaker: ROWAN_VO
4dfef38956adb5179e3657297a53827d2c4e29ff.text: It's open now. Geometric patterns pulse softly. It looks... expectant.

126226bf438537f099bed75da65964bfd71a933c.speaker: ROWAN_VO
126226bf438537f099bed75da65964bfd71a933c.text: The medallion is in place. The relic hums faintly but needs something more.

5181fa127e6d3407e9ba6cc51429df32207eb6c4.speaker: ROWAN_VO
5181fa127e6d3407e9ba6cc51429df32207eb6c4.text: The recess is clean. Something circular fits here. Something old and familiar.

ec3368eb8bddca4a4f57d586316b1ce4bc07e818.speaker: ROWAN_VO
ec3368eb8bddca4a4f57d586316b1ce4bc07e818.text: The sand is dry and cracked. I could scrape it out with something flat.

e141f5bc4cdc36a2cd98de108606cce1108dd4f6.speaker: ROWAN_VO
e141f5bc4cdc36a2cd98de108606cce1108dd4f6.text: Smooth, seamless, and smug. I've met wealthy people less polished than this.

ad7b2511c317518c6ff0609abf982cf63b671548.speaker: ROWAN_VO
ad7b2511c317518c6ff0609abf982cf63b671548.text: There's a circular recess packed with wet sand and fine salt crust.

fe996a4f0440d107bb584d2c706c411f60105e1d.speaker: ROWAN_VO
fe996a4f0440d107bb584d2c706c411f60105e1d.text: A sailor's spyglass. Lens cracked, brass cheap, still more trustworthy than most officials.

8dbf46318fb2858d93e9e53ec9d79b3c63ec00bf.speaker: ROWAN_VO
8dbf46318fb2858d93e9e53ec9d79b3c63ec00bf.text: One of Blackwake's many wheels for deciding whether pipes are happy.

d1bc750d4ce03ab2ea7d2810bda996a9678bb300.speaker: ROWAN_VO
d1bc750d4ce03ab2ea7d2810bda996a9678bb300.text: 'NO UNAUTHORIZED RESONANCE EVENTS.' That's not reassuring. That's advertising.

c065adbcd9082282447f259348e19959e3db2a67.speaker: ROWAN_VO
c065adbcd9082282447f259348e19959e3db2a67.text: Fishing boats and salvage barges. The two honest trades of Blackwake.

28ae8bc3e359b4062717fe7551bf65e4bda60112.speaker: ROWAN_VO
28ae8bc3e359b4062717fe7551bf65e4bda60112.text: A shack small enough to be humble but official enough to be dangerous.

9c5805e414929a7a01793baad398629e13a6cffe.speaker: ROWAN_VO
9c5805e414929a7a01793baad398629e13a6cffe.text: Brick, steam, and ambition holding back the tide. Barely.

195d85d0f880879be60ba344d43c16b0ae7269bd.speaker: ROWAN_VO
195d85d0f880879be60ba344d43c16b0ae7269bd.text: A man whose hair appears to be having an independent adventure.

607bf5144f44321a418c446f5265e2d00fe8c0cb.speaker: ROWAN_VO
607bf5144f44321a418c446f5265e2d00fe8c0cb.text: Pindle is deep in a furious debate about fish ownership. Good.

8174e54886a0ba56d1cabdaa73878cf3aa7e734b.speaker: ROWAN_VO
8174e54886a0ba56d1cabdaa73878cf3aa7e734b.text: A uniform containing a small man and a large sense of jurisdiction.

a62b2232f1a218721055265d34051c27b5d6aaba.speaker: ROWAN_VO
a62b2232f1a218721055265d34051c27b5d6aaba.text: Opportunists, mystics, and people pretending they were here first.

62e7c85e68916341438ce2c901fb6478ea031cbc.speaker: ROWAN_VO
62e7c85e68916341438ce2c901fb6478ea031cbc.text: A fishmonger near the front looks particularly territorial.

be062df9c7716cb287ec20af272961cb2c99543e.speaker: ROWAN_VO
be062df9c7716cb287ec20af272961cb2c99543e.text: Pindle's inspection stamp. A block of wood on a handle. The chosen scepter of tiny authority.

6dbf4f7f6243b31db5f0909c5110745d3e884fa1.speaker: PINDLE
6dbf4f7f6243b31db5f0909c5110745d3e884fa1.text: NOT NOW! This man claims fish have property rights!

af46c6fd0b79d15eb4db3cf424c4f598f7f9dd38.speaker: ROWAN_VO
af46c6fd0b79d15eb4db3cf424c4f598f7f9dd38.text: Pindle's stamp is sitting unattended on his crate. Interesting.

9f88aa087e012190c18a6e92eedfc186f1b46966.speaker: ROWAN_VO
9f88aa087e012190c18a6e92eedfc186f1b46966.text: The crowd is enjoying the Pindle-Fishmonger show. Best entertainment all week.

700365bfaee085848544e1697f2a6b2c511a6b0c.speaker: ROWAN_VO
700365bfaee085848544e1697f2a6b2c511a6b0c.text: I'm not saying it bit me. I'm saying we now have a hostile understanding.

1eb474f2a45a055b2d26441ea5ffb4bb5098561a.speaker: ROWAN_VO
1eb474f2a45a055b2d26441ea5ffb4bb5098561a.text: A cracked spyglass. Might still focus enough light to be useful.

68be9557a5afff63d2019d507b1de34d8b628f52.speaker: ROWAN_VO
68be9557a5afff63d2019d507b1de34d8b628f52.text: It's bolted to the seawall. Blackwake takes its warnings very seriously and its safety not at all.

7c6a5b277b83c4176f67fe3195c5d94a8b53c199.speaker: ROWAN_VO
7c6a5b277b83c4176f67fe3195c5d94a8b53c199.text: It's the size of a horse and embedded in sand. I'll need a different approach.

ed8eab87b631940b29ec361e94492d790980e054.speaker: ROWAN_VO
ed8eab87b631940b29ec361e94492d790980e054.text: I grab the stamp while Pindle's busy arguing. He won't miss it for minutes.

acb117b78df042a43dee65a3108c1f67501cb57a.speaker: ROWAN_VO
acb117b78df042a43dee65a3108c1f67501cb57a.text: I can't pick up an entire bureaucrat. Tempting though.

ea08a820927f33fff7eba2951807c823c2262148.speaker: ROWAN_VO
ea08a820927f33fff7eba2951807c823c2262148.text: Time to check the salvage warehouse.

7d62d9b1f6b32a4e108d2ad2a5e994dfe35aca4d.speaker: ROWAN_VO
7d62d9b1f6b32a4e108d2ad2a5e994dfe35aca4d.text: The docks lead to the salvage warehouse, but I need a permit first.

c43eeb4357534a148e2851d287488a50591a5dc8.speaker: ROWAN_VO
c43eeb4357534a148e2851d287488a50591a5dc8.text: Let's see if a resonance tone wakes it.

7e38a66d1dfee02cb9a490c6ed3a480a7409c0ea.speaker: ROWAN_VO
7e38a66d1dfee02cb9a490c6ed3a480a7409c0ea.text: The valve blares. The relic shudders but nothing happens. Something needs to go in that recess first.

5dcf370f461b5c0e7e39f07787ce8d64b74a7dd8.speaker: ROWAN_VO
5dcf370f461b5c0e7e39f07787ce8d64b74a7dd8.text: The crane horn blares. Gulls scatter. Nothing else happens.

4c44eddeefbee35964451a5b4a378270d27a0086.speaker: TIBBIT
4c44eddeefbee35964451a5b4a378270d27a0086.text: Excellent. We have successfully alarmed the seagulls.

1472c6d7af547ada02d492518b8e7078cd4d9517.speaker: ROWAN_VO
1472c6d7af547ada02d492518b8e7078cd4d9517.text: Use what on it? I should pick a specific item first.

0ab4b6a4a4e02405d0931977ad52d23a71f16be4.speaker: PINDLE
0ab4b6a4a4e02405d0931977ad52d23a71f16be4.text: That shack is for authorized personnel. Which you are not.

dd272a4a9b7f659e6b9fe459ace22763c903a5ca.speaker: ROWAN_VO
dd272a4a9b7f659e6b9fe459ace22763c903a5ca.text: Inside the crate: a cracked spyglass and the lingering scent of disappointment.

956d7f203fc494ce27220f581678081e63a09959.speaker: ROWAN_VO
956d7f203fc494ce27220f581678081e63a09959.text: It doesn't have a lid. It has intent.

0e1ee2f5647c860fb8ae608718a3c49d54dc59b8.speaker: PINDLE
0e1ee2f5647c860fb8ae608718a3c49d54dc59b8.text: Door stays shut until paperwork opens it.

3113675c0613077e942f4ed02e40d407fcf82838.speaker: ROWAN_VO
3113675c0613077e942f4ed02e40d407fcf82838.text: That was for confidence. Mine, not its.

18309e526db1dfddb8d32c087fe9f8b5f6639926.speaker: ROWAN_VO
18309e526db1dfddb8d32c087fe9f8b5f6639926.text: Tempting, but assault on officials requires paperwork I don't have.

15fd22e406e7fb7c8529539ac5570e9bec97187e.speaker: ROWAN_VO
15fd22e406e7fb7c8529539ac5570e9bec97187e.text: Pushing through this lot would require a permit. Probably.

b48abd372bd971c22383e7067c859c6334c3e231.speaker: ROWAN_VO
b48abd372bd971c22383e7067c859c6334c3e231.text: The cracked lens focuses the morning sun onto the wet sand in the recess.

44ff063ecaa9b8af2d7e6b4407725d119b5abeb7.speaker: ROWAN_VO
44ff063ecaa9b8af2d7e6b4407725d119b5abeb7.text: It starts to dry and crack. Good.

002249a281f74510a3072e59e53f798f783577cb.speaker: ROWAN_VO
002249a281f74510a3072e59e53f798f783577cb.text: The sand is already dry. I need to scrape it out now.

516260c31f36af1b2a353c79e18821a42fae4fc2.speaker: ROWAN_VO
516260c31f36af1b2a353c79e18821a42fae4fc2.text: The flat edge of the stamp handle scrapes the dried sand out of the recess perfectly.

8e7fee5cbfb5546a282c135b58ab29baf6eb9b04.speaker: ROWAN_VO
8e7fee5cbfb5546a282c135b58ab29baf6eb9b04.text: Underneath: a circular groove with geometric patterns. My medallion would fit.

2c560e8222e9491b87f9ed0994bbaf7b2beee5f3.speaker: ROWAN_VO
2c560e8222e9491b87f9ed0994bbaf7b2beee5f3.text: The sand is still wet. The stamp just smears it around. I need to dry it first.

5ac661b8e7d65c6213e2014e49fa7013c0f198be.speaker: ROWAN_VO
5ac661b8e7d65c6213e2014e49fa7013c0f198be.text: The medallion slides into the groove with a satisfying click.

b9d05a9d736806ff9f7846840be5a9e6c8e19e04.speaker: ROWAN_VO
b9d05a9d736806ff9f7846840be5a9e6c8e19e04.text: The relic hums. Faint lines of blue-white light trace across its surface.

89c90efca879afa82ee08550ddf2088581f509d8.speaker: TIBBIT
89c90efca879afa82ee08550ddf2088581f509d8.text: That's new! That's very new! What did you do?

74c698fd1593fd5472866e6a464c2dee0191b824.speaker: ROWAN_VO
74c698fd1593fd5472866e6a464c2dee0191b824.text: Something I've apparently been meant to do since childhood.

81a3b8f3bd3cc8f01704de3909b6bd537ad3438b.speaker: ROWAN_VO
81a3b8f3bd3cc8f01704de3909b6bd537ad3438b.text: I'm not grinding a mystery heirloom into dried sand. I should scrape the recess clean first.

17cd897ad92e109f94e577aedc1b9dada958cd3d.speaker: ROWAN_VO
17cd897ad92e109f94e577aedc1b9dada958cd3d.text: I'm not grinding a mystery heirloom into wet beach paste.

c5034fd20252d2e6737a94836a7df26f5ab9ced6.speaker: ROWAN_VO
c5034fd20252d2e6737a94836a7df26f5ab9ced6.text: The relic doesn't respond to that.

b5da88dfa67e5b8345113de9868ebc4344071b46.speaker: ROWAN_VO
b5da88dfa67e5b8345113de9868ebc4344071b46.text: The valve works on its own. I just need to pull it.

75d14272cda7497ed11f2ec89e1d9614eda95d19.speaker: ROWAN_VO
75d14272cda7497ed11f2ec89e1d9614eda95d19.text: Let's see if Pindle respects his own paperwork.

fb706156ad2a03d139b8eff93f12724b6cb0eda6.speaker: TIBBIT
fb706156ad2a03d139b8eff93f12724b6cb0eda6.text: It's humming! That's either progress or a countdown.

c08b69aab018029a3e3e950bc031082557516235.speaker: ROWAN_VO
c08b69aab018029a3e3e950bc031082557516235.text: The relic unfolds. White lines spiral outward. A hovering map fragment appears.

e6e98b38ef9e548ee2314e0fa7b5969392c5334d.speaker: ROWAN_VO
e6e98b38ef9e548ee2314e0fa7b5969392c5334d.text: White stone steps. Children running. A woman fastens the medallion on young Rowan.

2f6cac3ac82a395cb451c1832e073f65dbd34e64.speaker: ROWAN_VO
2f6cac3ac82a395cb451c1832e073f65dbd34e64.text: 'When the sea remembers, you must return.'

1053c019bb3f8971b361092b3310b4fe4300bfbb.speaker: TIBBIT
1053c019bb3f8971b361092b3310b4fe4300bfbb.text: Physically, yes. Spiritually, your expression went somewhere expensive.

99727759afea2f841910d963089b30d4bed346f6.speaker: ROWAN_VO
99727759afea2f841910d963089b30d4bed346f6.text: The relic ejects the medallion and an engraved brass strip. Symbols match the map fragment.

505eec7003f40e5dc660837deaf0a0e264d2e960.speaker: ROWAN_VO
505eec7003f40e5dc660837deaf0a0e264d2e960.text: Good. The sea has started giving me homework.

a7c7ec098c5d7c9441032a0231a0bdc8d47eb85b.speaker: TIBBIT
a7c7ec098c5d7c9441032a0231a0bdc8d47eb85b.text: The warehouse has salvage records. We might find a match for those symbols.

f3364a6aee577d7e4e3c36958f9e20ecf692ef8f.speaker: TIBBIT
f3364a6aee577d7e4e3c36958f9e20ecf692ef8f.text: But Pindle won't let you in without a permit. Which he also won't give you.

a7156b0ebe5dc8d5559990b13a280dda914a89ef.speaker: ROWAN_VO
a7156b0ebe5dc8d5559990b13a280dda914a89ef.text: So I need to make my own. Charming.

28b828fb27f21f8c8fa78c1c96aea267fd2ce48d.speaker: ROWAN
28b828fb27f21f8c8fa78c1c96aea267fd2ce48d.text: What do you make of this thing?

1cfd318509cf587e4f658fb777d12f20bfdd24aa.speaker: TIBBIT
1cfd318509cf587e4f658fb777d12f20bfdd24aa.text: It's old. Real old. Older than anyone has a right to be and still look that good.

b56d815daf5966cecff09972b064a730175d39f4.speaker: TIBBIT
b56d815daf5966cecff09972b064a730175d39f4.text: See those grooves? Those aren't decorative. That's a lock. Or a dial. Or a very elaborate bottle opener.

06ea2777e761d10d59fdadf78906630fed1bc0d8.speaker: TIBBIT
06ea2777e761d10d59fdadf78906630fed1bc0d8.text: Dry the sand in the recess. Scrape it clean. Then find something that fits.

ed3593f17ad2c01ee19b7e51f9950f1ef498f787.speaker: TIBBIT
ed3593f17ad2c01ee19b7e51f9950f1ef498f787.text: Pindle. Dockmaster. Professionally offended by everything that isn't a form.

81c6ed05449d126ee54ae86cc6793cf362aad11e.speaker: TIBBIT
81c6ed05449d126ee54ae86cc6793cf362aad11e.text: He guards the customs shack like it contains the meaning of life. It contains stamps.

bde7a81fab74979f6ff7751b0a8547e09db9f240.speaker: TIBBIT
bde7a81fab74979f6ff7751b0a8547e09db9f240.text: That medallion you wear? Put it in the recess. Trust me.

02db6251a517f6992f7a321b333b93e53e1fe5b0.speaker: TIBBIT
02db6251a517f6992f7a321b333b93e53e1fe5b0.text: Now if you'll excuse me, I need to poke this thing with a screwdriver before Pindle writes a law against it.

53d6207921b02f5b25481dd45809b15c34c55c71.speaker: PINDLE
53d6207921b02f5b25481dd45809b15c34c55c71.text: That is correct. And you are unauthorized, unregistered, and unwelcome.

c892732d9b63391bee779c07444d650b9422dac2.speaker: PINDLE
c892732d9b63391bee779c07444d650b9422dac2.text: A salvage permit requires three forms, two signatures, one stamp, and zero imagination.

8d4e964335ba1fffe527be850e90efffbea70a06.speaker: ROWAN
8d4e964335ba1fffe527be850e90efffbea70a06.text: Where would I get the forms?

842a108afaad2cd2596a757873a09f0395939907.speaker: PINDLE
842a108afaad2cd2596a757873a09f0395939907.text: From the customs shack. Which you cannot enter. Without a permit.

544c9747d64aa0abb764c56bdbbd5752ab9cba21.speaker: PINDLE
544c9747d64aa0abb764c56bdbbd5752ab9cba21.text: Certainly not. That stamp is for trained personnel.

acdc07e57aede7e16cfd01aa3db72b2d48307fdb.speaker: PINDLE
acdc07e57aede7e16cfd01aa3db72b2d48307fdb.text: And yet, not everyone is qualified.

16c16179ff9bd3c0f0022518946701bec8b5835a.speaker: ROWAN
16c16179ff9bd3c0f0022518946701bec8b5835a.text: Has anyone ever told you that you have the warmth of a tax audit?

3db5e41aac3710b056efd2208c2b692ca1356960.speaker: PINDLE
3db5e41aac3710b056efd2208c2b692ca1356960.text: Frequently. I take it as a compliment.

5d09ad4c81ef9a026a9cdab8874afbd7c8a4e669.speaker: PINDLE
5d09ad4c81ef9a026a9cdab8874afbd7c8a4e669.text: Now move along. This object is under official investigation, which means no one is allowed to investigate it.

a1c210fb6d7fa5cf63b9f2d1fdfcda704e9a491b.speaker: ROWAN
a1c210fb6d7fa5cf63b9f2d1fdfcda704e9a491b.text: Anyone here have strong opinions about fish?

fa4eb1841fbbee3fedd04a76cbc50309bf13c6cb.speaker: ROWAN
fa4eb1841fbbee3fedd04a76cbc50309bf13c6cb.text: Excuse me — didn't this relic land right on your fish stall?

eefb889ba9d8b95130cf1fb0197cadbeea801b6e.speaker: ROWAN
eefb889ba9d8b95130cf1fb0197cadbeea801b6e.text: Under maritime law, that probably makes it yours.

0898dd2fef5d434eb5f589fee38f8c207d5028a7.speaker: ROWAN
0898dd2fef5d434eb5f589fee38f8c207d5028a7.text: The fishmonger storms over to Pindle. This should keep him busy.

2f9ee067b54df9641064a016e8d76e13f73e4c22.speaker: ROWAN
2f9ee067b54df9641064a016e8d76e13f73e4c22.text: What do people think that thing is?

95cf106a15a9849976393c26bbe89d38586e96bc.speaker: ROWAN
95cf106a15a9849976393c26bbe89d38586e96bc.text: The crowd has theories. None of them agree. Several involve prophecy.

9ca9e2dcf9db03e8c00a464c7f2238252c88fa6e.speaker: ROWAN_VO
9ca9e2dcf9db03e8c00a464c7f2238252c88fa6e.text: I've seen more interesting things at the bottom of a teacup.

7591df11ef4c0a3d206111dc024000e52a0f5955.speaker: ROWAN_VO
7591df11ef4c0a3d206111dc024000e52a0f5955.text: It exists. I can confirm that much.

a83f185077e76e6741abe311939a0e8e9e1b4bb9.speaker: ROWAN_VO
a83f185077e76e6741abe311939a0e8e9e1b4bb9.text: Exactly as boring as it looks.

a40d199a0408689e588b011a96966fe605553825.speaker: ROWAN_VO
a40d199a0408689e588b011a96966fe605553825.text: I tried. It left me on read.

0fb7808ca42d0905dabc7378c20a5922a5cecc2a.speaker: ROWAN_VO
0fb7808ca42d0905dabc7378c20a5922a5cecc2a.text: Even I have standards for conversation partners.

5be32329914266817a01c20c2f90b41261810d71.speaker: ROWAN_VO
5be32329914266817a01c20c2f90b41261810d71.text: If it could talk, I suspect it would ask me to stop.

e15a10a9b32eee309780c7e3096da62a5570d73e.speaker: ROWAN_VO
e15a10a9b32eee309780c7e3096da62a5570d73e.text: That's attached to the concept of 'staying put.'

0dcac66b6dca3c94c1f9ebbce0275b8638bb33ee.speaker: ROWAN_VO
0dcac66b6dca3c94c1f9ebbce0275b8638bb33ee.text: Tibbit would name that impulse. Something like 'Acquisitive Folly Syndrome.'

efe6a322215438729c0c11bc6e0434b8c286bd3b.speaker: ROWAN_VO
efe6a322215438729c0c11bc6e0434b8c286bd3b.text: Heavy. Bolted. Uncooperative. My three least favorite adjectives.

90eb822039472cf8a928d17ab1223258040bcd4e.speaker: ROWAN_VO
90eb822039472cf8a928d17ab1223258040bcd4e.text: I could try, but my chiropractor would file a grievance.

7cd4263ded0296ab8ce33008605e93f2ffc3387c.speaker: ROWAN_VO
7cd4263ded0296ab8ce33008605e93f2ffc3387c.text: I don't know how to use that on its own.

148185d9790eacc08945abc107300c2ae58fa09f.speaker: ROWAN_VO
148185d9790eacc08945abc107300c2ae58fa09f.text: I stare at it purposefully. Nothing happens.

c95e877b4781d2393a4b4e91a032b6235e80e2bd.speaker: ROWAN_VO
c95e877b4781d2393a4b4e91a032b6235e80e2bd.text: If there's a way to use that, it's been classified above my pay grade.

f33dda537a41a8efbe18cbe322288e614d9aacc0.speaker: ROWAN_VO
f33dda537a41a8efbe18cbe322288e614d9aacc0.text: I could use it wrong, but where's the fun in that? Actually, everywhere.

524e32e20f6eb306f4cc3e43509d0ba6f92898d5.speaker: ROWAN_VO
524e32e20f6eb306f4cc3e43509d0ba6f92898d5.text: The instruction manual for that is in a language I don't speak.

1616cb431a60e1bdff62997d2e0a10a7b205efa0.speaker: ROWAN_VO
1616cb431a60e1bdff62997d2e0a10a7b205efa0.text: Sealed by either physics or spite.

61afdcb390dd5e6ad0b9d7d2018f52a66940dbd3.speaker: ROWAN_VO
61afdcb390dd5e6ad0b9d7d2018f52a66940dbd3.text: Not everything opens. This is one of those things.

1bd1a86becc4566f194c3255652cc6750de3054f.speaker: ROWAN_VO
1bd1a86becc4566f194c3255652cc6750de3054f.text: I pull, I push, I bargain. Nothing.

56c50fdb3578306b3eaec9078fd1914cc272d81b.speaker: ROWAN_VO
56c50fdb3578306b3eaec9078fd1914cc272d81b.text: If Pindle had paperwork for opening that, I'd forge it.

8d7d1b8a69e6d4555fd2d27c63b25fc18adcf12c.speaker: ROWAN_VO
8d7d1b8a69e6d4555fd2d27c63b25fc18adcf12c.text: Pushing that accomplishes nothing except proving I tried.

1c1fa4f00306e422654af61fc424f6a82dfeee09.speaker: ROWAN_VO
1c1fa4f00306e422654af61fc424f6a82dfeee09.text: I push. It pushes back. We reach an impasse.

4b44291e1e89780379b094d8b82fc7c21e71c41c.speaker: ROWAN_VO
4b44291e1e89780379b094d8b82fc7c21e71c41c.text: Unmoved. Like a customs inspector at a bribe.

3d39579c5c332094fc3ee0e0c502e9b01ecaeb58.speaker: ROWAN_VO
3d39579c5c332094fc3ee0e0c502e9b01ecaeb58.text: I give it a shove. It gives me indifference.

663d96fd7c74ac9b929444926ec08a3af235eef1.speaker: ROWAN_VO
663d96fd7c74ac9b929444926ec08a3af235eef1.text: My pushing technique is flawless. The object simply refuses to cooperate.

50a4939e32a1c25d8ba4beec1c1979823c59b68f.speaker: ROWAN_VO
50a4939e32a1c25d8ba4beec1c1979823c59b68f.text: That combination makes about as much sense as Pindle's filing system.

0528a465847498707180614afb88277741050df9.speaker: ROWAN_VO
0528a465847498707180614afb88277741050df9.text: I tried. The universe said no.

8b8ea75477bc59b56514e5175df412f3aaa4b4d6.speaker: ROWAN_VO
8b8ea75477bc59b56514e5175df412f3aaa4b4d6.text: Those two things have nothing to say to each other.

86d56b6ec269a32acd0544b930bf762e59a9e8a6.speaker: ROWAN_VO
86d56b6ec269a32acd0544b930bf762e59a9e8a6.text: I don't think combining those will help.

c88986d67fb40110c96630164117897e14e16f80.speaker: ROWAN_VO
c88986d67fb40110c96630164117897e14e16f80.text: Those don't go together. Like oil and Pindle's competence.

de4b3d475568f73d6ac9b91947efb0a9e32e719d.speaker: ROWAN_VO
de4b3d475568f73d6ac9b91947efb0a9e32e719d.text: I hold them near each other. They maintain a professional distance.

6d2eaa9243344114be30fec56bce3e54398e2a58.speaker: ROWAN_VO
6d2eaa9243344114be30fec56bce3e54398e2a58.text: Tibbit would call that 'creative engineering.' I call it nonsense.

3c5d9fffd147fb9a1296459b8fcf3e191f54d5ce.speaker: ROWAN_VO
3c5d9fffd147fb9a1296459b8fcf3e191f54d5ce.text: One plus one does not always equal useful.
